name: verification-observation-wiring
goal: Every declared scenario command runs its exact tests and records their real assertions; missing observations and extra targets fail closed.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: CI wrappers omit preview assertions, reject a stale catalog test list, and silently ignore the second metadata test file. Reproduce using actual runner commands.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: All four actual-command regressions fail: preview observations absent, catalog test list stale, metadata state omitted, and an extra target silently ignored. Log: /tmp/harness-verification-observation-red-20261017.log.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Use observed polling assertions, register the fifth catalog test, split binary/metadata commands, require preview assertions and reject extra targets before execution.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: All 13 tests pass: the four unchanged actual-command regressions plus nine strict runner/root boundary tests. Preview 7 cases, catalog 5 cases and all metadata/binary states are captured.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
